answer: Give every agent a willow-root stake that grows only through proven work. First, it locks 60 POA for 45 days and links one hardware key. Second, it completes 12 verified micro-jobs over 21 days, each signed by a different peer. Third, a weekly delta check compares its output against the median and freezes rewards on a sharp drop. Fraud burns the bond and voids the key for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 600,000 POA, 10,000 keys, and 120,000 signed jobs, over $3 million. Like a willow bending in a zephyr yet holding the riverbank, it flexes without letting fake roots take hold.
